profile.reading: This point in Lufkin, in Angelina County, Texas, near an address on Brentwood Drive, is named Precision Prints Lufkin Datacenter. Precision Prints appears to be a small local printing business, and the word Datacenter attached to its name most plausibly describes that company's own in house server room or IT closet used to run design, printing, and order management systems, rather than a commercial data center that leases space or connectivity to outside customers. Small businesses in many industries keep a closet or small room of servers and networking equipment to run their own operations, and such rooms are sometimes labeled in mapping data with the same tag used for genuine wholesale and retail data centers, which can make the two hard to tell apart without more information. No working website or independent business listing could be found for Precision Prints at this address to verify the scale of its computing equipment. Based on the business name and the small East Texas residential setting, this is filed as a probable small in house server closet rather than a commercial data center operation, and no capacity or specification figures are published for it.

reading.body:
This facility does not qualify as a commercial data center. OpenStreetMap marks a location in Lufkin, Angelina County, Texas, as "Precision Prints Lufkin Datacenter," but the name identifies a printing business with what appears to be an in-house server room supporting its own operations, not a facility leasing capacity to outside customers. No published specifications, power rating, or operator contact information could be confirmed despite exhaustive research.

Texas has 133 mapped data-center locations, of which 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 MW. This facility publishes no power figure and ranks outside the published capacity list.

This location does not factor into assessments of commercial AI infrastructure capacity.
